contract.advisoryText:
Source: Lying supine on an adjustable bench, gripping the barbell with hands at shoulder width, arms extended vertically above the chest.
Complete: Lower the barbell from above the chest to the mid-chest level by bending the elbows while keeping the upper arms close to the torso; Press the barbell upward from the mid-chest level back to the starting position above the chest by extending the elbows; finish/end state: Lying supine on an adjustable bench, gripping the barbell with hands at shoulder width, arms extended vertically above the chest.
Boundary: Exclude unrack the barbell from the squat rack; reposition the adjustable bench; rerack the barbell into the squat rack before or after the exercise action.
Reject: unrack the barbell from the squat rack; reposition the adjustable bench; rerack the barbell into the squat rack

contract.advisoryText:
Source: standing with barbell held at shoulder height in a front rack position, feet shoulder-width apart
Complete: descend into a deep squat while keeping the barbell in the front rack position; drive upward from the bottom of the squat to a full standing position; press the barbell overhead until arms are fully extended; lower the barbell back to the shoulder height front rack position; finish/end state: standing with barbell held at shoulder height in a front rack position, feet shoulder-width apart
Boundary: Exclude unrack barbell; rerack barbell before or after the exercise action.
Reject: unrack barbell; rerack barbell
